short_summary.text: Merit-cum-means scholarship for eligible students pursuing regular undergraduate, postgraduate and specified professional higher education. Intended audience noted in the scheme record: Class XII pass-outs above the 80th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant stream/board, enrolled in the first year of a regular eligible degree course. Recorded assistance includes ₹12,000 per annum for the first three undergraduate years; ₹20,000 per annum for postgraduate study and specified fourth/fifth-year technical study, subject to course-specific rules.

schemes.official_name: Educational Scholarship Scheme (Madhya Pradesh Labour Welfare Board)

short_summary.text: Course-level scholarship for eligible children of workers employed in industrial units/establishments within the Madhya Pradesh Labour Welfare Board’s scope. Intended audience noted in the scheme record: Up to two children of workers employed in industrial units/establishments within the Board’s scope, studying regularly in MP institutions from Class 5 to higher education. Recorded assistance includes Course-level awards listed by MP page: ₹2,000 (Classes 5–8), ₹4,450 (9–10), ₹4,700 (11–12), ₹5,000 (ITI/polytechnic diploma), ₹7,700 (general graduate and PG), ₹10,000 (engineering and law), ₹12,500 (MBBS/BDS), ₹9,000 (pharmacy/nursing and listed medical courses), ₹11,500 (M.E./M.Tech), and other listed course rates.

MP page states central share 60% and state share 40%; selection by online lottery and payment via DBT.

short_summary.text: Free monthly foodgrain entitlement for households already identified as Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) or Priority Household (PHH) under NFSA, through the Public Distribution System. Intended audience noted in the scheme record: Existing NFSA AAY households and Priority Household beneficiaries. Recorded assistance includes AAY: 35 kg foodgrains per household per month. PHH: 5 kg foodgrains per person per month, free of cost under continuation from 1 January 2024 for five years.
